title: Crimp Press
pages: Craft the controller with plain pistons, diamonds and tempered steel from the Quench Vat. Put a diamond block beneath it and a stonecutter above it. Face plain pistons inward on the east and west sides. Place obsidian beneath both pistons as anvil feet, chains above both pistons and iron bars north and south of the stonecutter to brace the suspended wheel; the controller remains open at hand height.

Right-click the controller with feedstock from a loaded crimping recipe. The press loads one recipe batch into its stock buffer, processes it over 40 ticks, and holds the output for empty-hand collection or bottom-face extraction. A missing diamond base, stonecutter wheel, inward piston, obsidian foot, suspension chain or overhead iron brace stops operation. Use the structure projector to see all ten parts.

It runs 21 exclusive datapack crimping recipes, each shown in JEI with its batch size, 40-tick time and frame parts; every recipe has its own input, so a held stack never matches two rows. Three feeds make the crimped collar: three iron ingots, four tempered steel or one sealed steel plate. The other eighteen fold, roll and crimp sheet metal into finished goods costed at or above their crafting-table price: 22 iron nuggets into 2 chains, 18 gold nuggets into a light weighted pressure plate, 3 copper ingots into a lightning rod, 6 gold ingots into a clock, 7 diamonds into diamond horse armor, 3 zirconium into a bucket, 2 tungsten into a heavy weighted pressure plate, 7 osmium into a cauldron, 6 molybdenum into 16 iron bars, 5 platinum into a minecart, 4 hafnium into an iron trapdoor, 6 rhenium into 3 iron doors, 31 antimony into an anvil and 7 bismuth into a bell. Interlinked mail rings are crimped shut into chainmail, otherwise uncraftable: germanium 5 (helmet), tantalum 8 (chestplate), gallium 7 (leggings), indium 4 (boots). These give the corrosion-proof and dense t4 metals a bulk use for buckets, minecarts, doors and armor. It has no FE port; formed controllers also hold buffered stock and output for sided item automation.

Crimped collars terminate coil windings: two sit in the bottom corners of the Induction Coiler controller either side of a Smoke Rack-made Creosote Lagging, under a copper ingot / Insulated Pulse Contact / fired Brazed Joint row and a lightning rod / silver ingot / lightning rod top row. A third collar retains the contact stack inside the Insulated Pulse Contact itself. Keep the Crimp Press after the Press; the Resonance Infuser cannot be reached without its collars, and a lightning rod does not substitute for a collar.

Automation: place a hopper or item pipe against any input face (all faces except the bottom by default) and feed a loaded recipe input. A formed controller processes one batch every 40 ticks without FE; its bottom face outputs to a hopper or pipe. Empty-hand right-click collects buffered products. Sneak-right-click a face with an empty hand cycles it through input, output and off. Full output pauses processing; broken or unloaded structures do not process. Buffered items and side settings survive saving; breaking the controller drops its buffers.
